body:
**[SUGGESTION]:** `build` now depends on `go build -o` creating parent directories on every supported toolchain

Removing `mkdir -p "$(dir $(BUILD_OUTPUT))"` makes this recipe (and the new `test_scripts.sh` "accepts isolated output" assertion) rely on the Go toolchain creating missing output parents. The retained R2 evidence covers `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.1` only, but the CI "Linux — minimum compiler" job pins `go-version: 1.25.0` with `GOTOOLCHAIN=local` and runs `make ... validate ...`, whose `test-scripts` gate executes that assertion; parent-directory creation for `-o` is not documented `go build` behavior and has historically not held on all toolchains (the pre-PR Makefile carried the `mkdir` presumably for that reason). If 1.25.0 lacks it, the next hosted minimum run fails, as does `make clean && make build` with the default `bin/tusk`. Consider an injection-safe `@mkdir -p "$$(dirname "$$BUILD_OUTPUT")"` before this line, or record a toolchain-floor verification so the next hosted run does not rediscover this.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
